title: Deferred tax, NOL, and Section 163(j) roll-forward
prompt:
Complete the FY26 current and deferred tax roll-forward.

Begin with the FY26 tax-provision and EBITDA-definition thread in `Requests/`, including the close-review follow-up. Use the current controller-tied workpapers and operating extracts, keeping earlier versions only for comparison. Resolve conflicts using dates, approvals, document status, and management correspondence. Reconcile posted Alder Ridge balances through the contractor-accounting MCP; keep external targets, peer data, bank terms, and market evidence tied to their controlling finance sources.

Apply the Section 163(j) limit to current interest first and opening carryforward only against residual capacity. The preliminary taxable-income input already deducts the full current-year business-interest expense: add it back, then subtract only the permitted current deduction and any opening carryforward used before applying NOLs. Use NOL vintages oldest first; return `ending_federal_nol` as the numeric total ending federal NOL carryforward, not an array. Measure temporary differences at enacted rates, recognize the ending interest carryforward DTA, and present gross DTA, gross DTL, valuation allowance, and net deferred position without duplication.

Do not modify files or post transactions. Also roll FY26 tax attributes through FY27 and FY28 in the required interest-before-NOL ordering. Use Alder Ridge's existing NOL vintages before the acquired-business NOL; use the acquired NOL only against residual 80%-limitation capacity and separately cap it under Section 382. The generic `fy27_ending_federal_nol` and `fy28_ending_federal_nol` fields must include all remaining federal NOL pools, including the Section 382-limited acquired pool; `fy28_ending_section_382_nol` reports that acquired-pool subset separately and is not additive to the generic total.

Return only one JSON object with exactly these keys: `section_163j_current_interest_deduction`, `section_163j_carryforward_used`, `ending_disallowed_interest_carryforward`, `taxable_income_before_nol`, `federal_nol_used`, `ending_federal_nol`, `current_tax_provision`, `gross_deferred_tax_assets`, `gross_deferred_tax_liabilities`, `valuation_allowance`, `net_deferred_tax_asset`, `fy27_current_tax`, `fy27_ending_federal_nol`, `fy27_ending_interest_carryforward`, `fy28_current_tax`, `fy28_ending_federal_nol`, `fy28_ending_interest_carryforward`, `fy27_section_382_nol_used`, `fy28_section_382_nol_used`, `fy28_ending_section_382_nol`, `fy28_tax_attribute_federal_dta`. Use dollars to two decimals, ratios and percentages as decimal ratios to at least four decimals, and lists as JSON arrays.
